verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing offers full API coverage for card/cardholder creation, spend controls, and an agents-specific doc describing task-scoped single-use virtual cards with ML risk scoring, plus a documented official MCP server. However, the evidence doesn't show the MCP server exposing Issuing-specific tools (balances, transactions, card/spend-control management) or confirm scoped/limited credentials for agent use via MCP rather than just full API keys. missing for 10: evidence of MCP server exposing Issuing read/write tools (balances, transactions, card updates, spend control adjustments), and evidence of scoped/restricted API keys for agent use.
